a: A pronoun referring back to the Word of Majesty (Allah), exalted is His status.

A name of the Most High Essence, unique in divinity, whose existence is necessary, worshipped by right; it is the Word of Majesty (lafz al-jalalah) comprehending the meanings of all of Allah’s perfect attributes.
One, Single, with no likeness and no equal. It is also said: One who is not divided into parts and is not split; Allah is one in every attribute.
